purpose: Predeclared deployed topology qualification plan; T001 defines the protocol but does not execute the production bakeoff.

required: Build once from frozen toolchain; record OCI image digest, source SHA, lock digest and IaC revision.
Deploy identical application image/config contract to each candidate with candidate-only adapter/IaC deltas.
Capture exact region, service sizes, replica/task/pod counts, database class/config, storage class and telemetry configuration.
Meter all candidate-specific billable resources and mark unavailable billing data NOT_OBSERVED.
Run at least two concurrently eligible API/worker execution units or provider-equivalent multi-instance topology.
Prove no correctness dependence on local filesystem or process affinity.
Exercise concurrent ownership/CAS/fencing, duplicate delivery, stale writer, out-of-order result, timeout-after-side-effect and process crash before checkpoint.
Reopen state from fresh processes/instances and verify authoritative event/state equivalence.
Execute exact beginner/intermediate/advanced x article/carousel/short_video membership with stable run/job/branch identities.
Run cross-tenant API/data/object/event/trace attempts; unauthorized successes must remain zero.
Exercise revocation/org-switch/session/cursor behavior against deployed adapters.
Run upload size/type/content/path abuse, quarantine-to-accepted transition and immutable source-hash/provenance checks.
Verify least-privilege service identity and secret access boundaries.

Use a predeclared adaptive load ladder beginning at concurrency 1 and doubling until the first observed saturation/guardrail/provider limit or predeclared budget ceiling; do not invent a supported-user target.

For every rung capture raw request/run latency samples, p50/p95/p99, throughput, queue depth/time, retries, errors, CPU, memory, DB connections/locks, autoscaling/replica state and infrastructure cost.
Repeat independent windows and retain all outliers; report sample counts and uncertainty. If a rung cannot be completed, record censored/missing rather than substituting a lower rung.
Exercise explicit overload/backpressure and verify idempotent rejection/retry behavior.
Kill/restart worker and API units during in-flight exact-3x3 runs.
Force database connection interruption and provider-supported HA failover where safely available; measure observed interruption/recovery without declaring an SLO/RTO.
Exercise stale ownership epoch/fencing and delayed duplicate results after failover.
Temporarily deny object access and separately interrupt telemetry export; product authoritative state/events must remain correct and telemetry outage must not become product truth.
Exercise secret version rotation/revocation and rolling deployment while work is in flight.
Create/identify a production-topology backup point, mutate known state afterward, then restore to an isolated target.
Execute point-in-time recovery when the managed database supports it; never overwrite the only source during the test.
Reconnect a fresh application deployment to the restored target and verify tenant bindings, run/job/branch identities, authoritative events, source hashes and replay.
Record observed restore duration, latest restorable point, any loss/mismatch and all manual/operator steps; defined scenario must pass 100% before a production claim.
Use an expand/contract migration fixture: N -> additive N+1, mixed-version read/write period, backfill/reconciliation, then application rollback while schema remains backward compatible.
Measure migration duration, lock/block time, errors, incompatible reads/writes and rollback duration.
Prove zero accepted branch/state/provenance loss or duplication across migration.
For destructive rollback, require an explicit restore/PITR plan and do not claim reversibility from an unexecuted script.
Export traces, metrics and structured logs through OTLP-compatible instrumentation/collector with request/run/job/tenant correlation.
Capture telemetry ingest success/failure, queryability, ingest/query latency where observable, dropped data, cardinality and backend cost/usage.
Inject secret/content canaries and verify zero unauthorized leakage.
Prove telemetry remains best-effort/non-authoritative and that collector/backend outage does not corrupt durable product state/events.
Execute fresh declarative deploy from clean credentials/context, health/startup checks, rolling/revision deployment and rollback.
Record commands/automation steps, wall-clock operation durations, manual interventions, failed-step recovery and operator prerequisites.
Record exact deployment identity and link it to source/build/image/IaC/database migration identities.
Do not convert documentation claims into measured operational evidence.
Capture provider pricing snapshot/date plus measured billable usage for compute, database, load balancer/networking, object storage, backups, telemetry and secrets where available.
Report raw cost per qualification window and per successful exact-3x3 run when computable; otherwise NOT_OBSERVED with reason.
Apply hard gates, then raw multidimensional metrics, uncertainty/missingness, then point Pareto.
Emit LOCK only if the T001 decision rule is satisfied; otherwise NO_PREFERENCE/PENDING_EVIDENCE.

uncertainty_policy.repetition: Use repeated independent windows wherever variance matters; persist count and configuration. Do not fabricate significance from insufficient samples.
uncertainty_policy.missingness: Required missing objectives prevent the affected Pareto/lock computation; mark NOT_OBSERVED/NOT_APPLICABLE with reason.

evidence_saturation.research_stop: Stop source research when each decision criterion has current high-authority evidence and an additional systematic source pass introduces no materially different candidate, failure mode, constraint or evidence capable of changing eligibility/protocol.
evidence_saturation.execution_stop: Do not stop T002 merely because one candidate leads early. Complete every predeclared eligible candidate unless a hard gate fails; after hard-gate failure, preserve raw evidence and stop only unsafe/costly later phases for that candidate.
lock_reopen_conditions: New production workload/geography or compliance constraint.
Material provider/runtime version or pricing/limit change.
New hard-gate failure or security/reliability incident.
Previously missing required objective becomes observable.
A materially different candidate becomes feasible and can alter Pareto membership.
Representative business utility evidence becomes available and is frozen before outcomes.
